svg.text: New architecture: Job API replaces the parent worker (example: fine-tune job on NERSC)
runs anywhere with HTTPS to NERSC
1–8: job path (training / batch inference, Prefect-orchestrated). One job → one target → ONE child work pool
✗ = pool not selected for this job. Multi-step jobs (train → inference) stay in the same pool. Not shown: conda · podman · slurm pools
